newsitem.title: UK: UK govt confirms Clementi as BOE deputy governor.
newsitem.headline: UK govt confirms Clementi as BOE deputy governor.

text.p: The British government confirmed on Thursday that David Clementi, former vice president of Dresdner Bank's investment bank unit Kleinwort Benson Group, is the new deputy governor of the Bank of England replacing Howard Davies.
The announcement has been widely expected since a newspaper leak at the weekend.
The appointment is for five years starting in September.

Once the legislation for a second deputy governor is in place, the central bank's chief economist Mervyn King will take up that position and Clementi will become the deputy governor supporting the Governor on financial stability issues.
He will also remain responsible for the day to day running of the Bank.
Bank of England Governor Eddie George said he was delighted that David Clementi had been appointed.
